|game_text=If Rebel Strike Team on table, deploy on table. Unless opponent's [Endor] objective on table, opponent generates no Force at your Endor system. Twice per game, may ▲ an [Endor] or [Death Star II] leader. May ▼ [Death Star II] Falcon to Endor system. [Immune to Alter]
|errata_history=The December 2024 erratum changes the deployment requirement from an A New Hope objective to Rebel Strike Team and stops the opponent from generating Force at your Endor system unless they have an Endor objective. The leader search now applies to Endor or Death Star II leaders, and the first-turn Obi-Wan deployment modifier is replaced by deployment of the Death Star II Falcon.<ref name="strike-planning-december-errata" />
